findings.desc: CHK-002:adversarial:1 evidence is audit_only and claims unicode/quoted-path coverage exists in the upstream classifier own tests, but no such test appears to exist. unquoteGitPath in dirty-worktree.ts is exercised by parseGitPorcelainRow in flow-stability-smoke via rename rows, but no smoke exercises an actual octal-escaped, git-quoted unicode path through classifyGitStatusRows. The delegation claim is not demonstrably grounded. A single row like `?? \"packages/main/src/caf\\303\\251.ts\"` through classifyGitStatusRows asserting the path is correctly unquoted and classified would close this gap cheaply.
